reviews.review_title: The 8mm freshwater pink pearl strand…
reviews.review_text: The 8mm freshwater pink pearl strand necklace is gorgeous! I bought a pair of the pink pearl earrings to match. The arrived earlier than I anticipated which was a pleasant surprise. They look great with my mother of the groom dress. I can’t wait to wear them. I’m very pleased  and would highly recommend The Pearl Source.

It's lovely to know they arrived earlier than expected and pair so beautifully with your mother-of-the-groom dress. We hope you enjoy wearing them on the special day.

reviews.review_title: I bought this for my wife's birthday…
reviews.review_text: I bought this for my wife's birthday June 2nd. It's one of her birth stones and I found this company on social media. I did my do diligence to make sure of the legitimacy, quality etc. Everything checked out so I bought a pearl with a rose overtime instead basic white. I'm glad I did. It's beautiful, and the color shows very nicely. The quality is excellent the pendant is sturdy and well constructed. The size is just right too. 8-8.5 mm AA+ quality. Would highly recommend this company and it's products. Will be buying the matching earrings. Delivery was efficient, updates to know where and when delivery is coming.
reviews.reply_text: Thank you for sharing your experience. We’re delighted the rose overtone pearl was the perfect choice for your wife’s birthday and that you were pleased with its color, quality, and craftsmanship. We're also glad the delivery process was smooth and kept you informed every step of the way. Thank you for choosing The Pearl Source, and we look forward to welcoming you back in the future.

reviews.review_title: Poorly  Packed for Shipping
reviews.review_text: I deducted one start because of the way the pearls were found upon arrival. I am very fussy about pearls and did not appreciate the right top clip being open so the entire trip my pearls were rubbing against each other. There needed to be a cushion layer above the pearls to hold them firmly in place to prevent rubbing against the box and each other. Otherwise, the purchase was fine.
reviews.reply_text:
Hello,
Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We're sorry to hear the packaging did not meet your expectations upon arrival. Your comments regarding the clasp and the need for additional cushioning to better protect the pearls during transit will be shared with our team. We're glad the rest of your purchase experience was a positive one.

Best regards,
The Pearl Source

reviews.review_title: Terrible Company
reviews.review_text: This company does not stand by their product. My fiance bought me a very expensive pearl ring and one year later the pearl fell off of the post. I sent it back and  they said that it was fixed and a couple months later it fell off for a second time. I pleaded for them to just replace the ring at this point; but they didn’t.   They guaranteed me for the SECOND time that it wouldn’t happen another time.  I was incredibly lucky that it fell off in front of me both times.  Well, a month ago, it happened again in the middle of a grassy field! This time the pearl was not to be found! They said they would repair  it for $278. Unfortunately, I no longer have the pearl anymore!!!! Not good enough for the third time! Extremely disappointing! I would NEVER recommend this company!!
reviews.reply_text: We are truly sorry to hear about the repeated issues with your pearl ring and the frustration this has caused, especially losing the pearl. We understand how disappointing this experience has been. We are committed to improving our product quality and repair processes. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention.
